dogecoin.text: I use Robinhood for my investing. When I am not spending my cash or holding it I invest it into dogecoin. It doesnt cost much the adoption rate is high and its a decent long term investment for anyone trying to learn Crypto shares. I just look for that average low and buy in

The president once said #Crypto is unreliable with a random volatility.

At a glance this is true. However, $BTC, $LTC, $XRP, $XLM heck even $DOGE are all high liquidity assets that could pop during a distrust in the fiat USD during an economic crisis.
